items.headline: O: GPT-6.1 Terra rollout to API and Work/Codex
items.summary: O rolled out GPT-6.1 Terra in the O API (gpt-6.1-terra) and in ChatGPT Work and Codex, with stated pricing and capability notes for visual reasoning, computer use, and writing.

items.headline: V: W-7 mission advances in-orbit manufacturing testing
items.summary: Reporting around V’s W-7 launch highlights continued in-orbit work for microgravity manufacturing (including drug-candidate objectives) and progress toward next operational capacity.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 expands to more users
items.summary: O announced GPT-6 availability expanding beyond its initial paid launch, framing broader access for ChatGPT users and a larger deployment scope for GPT-6 model family.
